answer: Charge sybils in memory and time: each epoch an account must solve a memory-hard puzzle needing 1 GB of RAM for about 60 seconds, seeded by a public beacon hashed with its own key. Accounts from one /24 subnet form an island, and the puzzle for its n-th member needs 2^(n-1) times the work, so ten clones cost 512 times the first. Each solved puzzle is a cheap-to-check vertex hash on the public ledger, so anyone can verify it, and failures forfeit 10 POA of bond.
